notes: Zhihu has four selector forms for different page types: .Post-RichTextContainer (column articles), .RichContent-inner (single answer body), .QuestionRichText (question description), .AnswerCard (answer wrapper). The fixture is an answer page; suggest_selector returns the comma-joined list and the test checks that the question's .QuestionRichText is locatable (any of the four candidates would satisfy expected_selector_candidates).
